svg.aria-label: The six logic gates with their standard symbols, logic expressions, truth tables and functions. NOT: output is the opposite of the input. AND: 1 only if both inputs are 1. OR: 1 if either or both inputs are 1. NAND: 0 only if both inputs are 1. NOR: 1 only if both inputs are 0. XOR: 1 if the inputs are different.
